kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحاضنت (form VI)
# تَحَاضَنْتُ (taḥāḍantu) /ta.ħaː.dˤan.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# تَحَاضَنْتَ (taḥāḍanta) /ta.ħaː.dˤan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# تَحَاضَنْتِ (taḥāḍanti) /ta.ħaː.dˤan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَاضَنَ (taḥāḍana)
# تَحَاضَنَتْ (taḥāḍanat) /ta.ħaː.dˤa.nat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
